questions.qtext:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer to the following question from the four alternatives given below.

People by and large are concerned with and pursue self-interest. They are unlikely to be motivated to use renewable resources in a prudent and sustainable fashion if they believe that others may overuse or deplete those resources. However, people are more likely to conserve resources when they have secure control over them, when substitutes are not readily available, and when they are rooted in a locality. Such people are also more likely to protect biodiversity and ensure the sustainable use of renewable resources.

According to the passage, under which condition are people most likely to use renewable resources sustainably?

options.text: When they expect others to exploit the resources freely.
When they have secure control over the resource base and are connected to their locality
When renewable resources are available in unlimited quantity.
When substitutes for renewable resources are easily available.

questions.solution: The passage clearly states that people are more likely to use renewable resources sustainably when they have secure control over the resource base, substitutes are not readily available, and they are rooted in a locality. These conditions encourage responsible use and conservation of biodiversity. Therefore, Option (B) is the correct answer.

questions.qtext:
The Nyquist plot of an open-loop transfer function of a negative feedback control system is shown below.

If the open-loop system is stable, then the closed loop system will be having _______ poles in RHS.

Numerical answer type
questions.solution:
The number of encirclements to the critical point (–1 + j0) = 2
N = P – Z
P = Number of open-loop poles in RHS of s-plane = 0 (∴ open loop system is stable)
Z = Number of closed loop poles in RHS of s-plane.
2 = 0 – Z
or, Z = 2
The system is unstable with two RHS closed loop poles.

Given number is 1100

sign magnitude of 1100 is = –4 = B
2's complement of 1100 is = –4 = C
so, A + B + C = –11

questions.qtext: For 3-bit synchronous counter configuration shown below, the delay of the bubbled NAND gate is 2 nsec and that of a counter is assumed to be zero. If the clock frequency is 1 GHz, then counter will act like a _____.
questions.solution:
Given, clock frequency = 1 GHz
clock time period = 1 nsec
If the propagation delay of the NAND gate were 0 nsec, then circuit would behave as MOD-6 counter.
However the delay of NAND gate is 2 nano sec. During this time two more clock pulse will arrive the counter.
∴ 2 more states will be counted.
∴ The counter is MOD-8 counter.
